results.name: Function-change classification, policy review and simplified default panel
UI to durable job file to result to user approval to independent document phase
Rework is automatically dispatched and old results cannot overwrite new requirements
Optional explanation posts into the same request and reaches the agent outbox
Ambiguous submission is never labelled working and is never blindly resent
Mask, Escape, draft reload and marker navigation remain intact
Native OMR popup and iframe input lock remain usable with the simpler panel
390px panel with reduced choices and a usable marking tray
New feature requests and unsubmitted explanations survive JSON migration
Unpersisted agent result stays in memory and is not acknowledged as durably applied
Late begin cannot regress a result; document errors stay visible through receipt replay

transport: Isolated transport fixture; real UI, Python job/result files and command argument construction. Live Orca receipt is recorded separately.
